## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A three-*juàn* Sòng-period commentary on DZ 318 *Jiǔtiān shēngshén zhāngjīng* ([KR5b0002](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5b/KR5b0002)), composed in 1205 by Wáng Xīcháo 王希巢 (*zì* Yǐnxián 隱賢), a Daoist of the Chóngxū guàn 崇虛觀 in Miǎnzhōu 綿州 (Sichuan).

**Abstract**

Dated to 1205 by the author's preface (Schmidt in Schipper & Verellen, *Taoist Canon* 2: 727, DZ 397). The commentary is unusually detailed and precise in its textual criticism (e.g. 1.5b–6b); the two hymns by the Tàijí zhēnrén 太極真人 at the close of the parent scripture are left uncommentated. The author, a *dàoshì* of the Chóngxū guàn in Miǎnzhōu (Sichuan), explicitly situates himself within the broad Sòng commentarial line while distinguishing his work from the shorter or less thorough earlier treatments.

This is the middle of the three Sòng–Yuán commentaries on the *Shēngshén zhāngjīng* preserved in the canon; DZ 396 (Dǒng Sījìng, 1252, [KR5b0080](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5b/KR5b0080)) cites Wáng's work as the "Sichuan commentary" (*Shǔ zhù* 蜀註), and DZ 398 (Huáyáng fù, 1332, [KR5b0082](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5b/KR5b0082)) draws heavily on it.
